name: axe-core WCAG audit (no serious/critical violations)
source: Deque axe-core (90+ rules, each tagged to WCAG 2.1 A/AA Success Criteria)
description: Runs axe-core 4.9.1 against the live page and reports violations grouped by impact. Fails if any serious or critical violation is present. axe-core implements rules tagged to the W3C WCAG 2.1 A/AA Success Criteria — color-contrast (1.4.3), image-alt (1.1.1), button-name (4.1.2), label (3.3.2), link-name (2.4.4), and ~85 others.
rationale: axe-core is the industry-standard automated accessibility testing engine. Every rule is grounded in a specific WCAG Success Criterion and is conservatively tuned to avoid false positives. Catching axe violations is non-negotiable: it represents the floor of accessibility compliance and the violations are usually easy to fix once surfaced. Source: <https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core> rule descriptions.
pass_criteria: Zero violations of impact level 'serious' or 'critical' on the rendered page.
